verdict.rationale: Docs show that key admin actions (virtual keys, budgets, teams, cost tracking, logging) are configurable via JSON/API-style config as well as the admin UI (litellm-docs-7, -8, -25, -26), and MCP tools can be called via a REST endpoint without an LLM (litellm-docs-33). But some flows are documented as UI-first with no shown API equivalent (e.g., adding an MCP server is described only via the UI in litellm-docs-27), and no OpenAPI/swagger spec was discoverable (litellm-probe-3), leaving API parity for all UI actions unconfirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or OpenAPI spec showing every admin-UI action (e.g., MCP server registration, guardrail configuration, SSO/SCIM setup) has a documented API equivalent, and independent confirmation that this parity holds in practice.
